page.overview:
Who is Blanka-chan?

Blanka-chan was design to be "off-putting when you first look at it, but cute once you get used to it."

In Street Fighter V, Blanka was told that if he sold plushies of himself, he would become popular, so he asked to make many Blanka-chan plushies. However, he was overstocked and had no luck selling his plushies, which made his mother sad. After learning of Blanka's situation, Laura realized that he was tricked by the manufacturer. Laura's brother, Sean, suggests to try selling them in Japan, as they like strange things and it could become popular if it appeared in an anime or video game. In Japan, Sakura helped Blanka by making his plushies prizes from a crane game.

In Street Fighter 6, Blanka launched an online advertisement campaign featuring Blanka-chan as an "cryptid sprite" mascot, wearing a Blanka-chan costume as part of his tourism business.

Blanka-chan plushies are one of the objects that can appear in Oro's Tengu Stone in Street Fighter V.
